scientific_integrity: Standalone checker tests finite examples only; infinite statements derive analytically from the proof and have not had independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional affine exactness, iid nodes with bounded continuous sampling density, unconstrained minimum Euclidean weights, independent centered finite-variance observation errors; no assertion for positive or conditioned methods. Specialist publication precedence remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp heavy tails and a four-node mean-square threshold for unconstrained affine-exact random quadrature
